---
title: "How far can aspect ratio be pushed before strut penalties erode glide gains?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 191.3      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Execute aspect ratio trade accounting for strut drag, chord Reynolds reduction, and mass
trade = sbw_drag_mass_trade(airplane)

ar_base = float(trade["AR"][0])
ar_max = float(trade["AR"][-1])
ar_diminish = float(trade["AR"][3])
span_diminish = float(trade["span"][3])
dld_thresh = float(trade["dld_dar"][3])

ld_max = float(trade["max_LD"][-1])
ld_base = float(trade["max_LD"][0])
cant_ld_base = float(trade["cant_LD"][0])
delta_ld_base = float(ld_base - cant_ld_base)

pct_drag_base = float((cant_ld_base / ld_base - 1.0) * 100)
ar_breakeven = float(np.interp(cant_ld_base, trade["max_LD"], trade["AR"]))
l_strut_max = float(trade["L_strut"][-1])

sigma_allow_MPa = 350.0
t_skin_mm = 1.2
m_fittings = 2.0
best_ld = ld_max
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{best_ld:.1f}"`]{.hero-value}
[maximum achievable glide ratio with strut bracing across realistic aspect ratios]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** With [bending moment relieved by the strut](2026-09-30-01-how-does-a-strut-braced-wing-change-the-aspect-ratio-to-bending-moment.qmd), aspect ratio can be extended from [`{python} f"{ar_base:.1f}"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{ar_diminish:.0f}"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{span_diminish:.1f} m"`]{.key} span) before marginal glide gains diminish below [`{python} f"{dld_thresh:.2f}"`]{.key} per aspect ratio unit (@fig-sbw-erosion). At [`{python} f"{ar_base:.1f}"`]{.key}, the strut imposes a [`{python} f"{delta_ld_base:.1f}"`]{.key} glide penalty ([`{python} f"{pct_drag_base:.1f}%"`]{.key} drag), breaking even with the [cantilever baseline](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-02-does-the-reconstructed-discus-2c-achieve-its-published-45-9-glide-rati.qmd) near [`{python} f"AR {ar_breakeven:.0f}"`]{.key}. Beyond [`{python} f"AR {ar_diminish:.0f}"`]{.key}, growing strut parasitic drag ([`{python} f"{l_strut_max:.1f} m"`]{.key} length) and chord Reynolds degradation erode returns, reaching a best achievable glide ratio of [`{python} f"{ld_max:.1f}"`]{.key} at [`{python} f"AR {ar_max:.0f}"`]{.key}.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **strut allowable stress: `{python} f"{sigma_allow_MPa:.0f} MPa"`**, composite tensile limit.
2. **strut shell thickness: `{python} f"{t_skin_mm:.1f} mm"`**, aerodynamic HQ010 casing.
3. **strut fitting mass: `{python} f"{m_fittings:.1f} kg"`**, attachment hardware per strut.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-sbw-erosion
#| fig-cap: "Glide ratio and drag breakdown across aspect ratios comparing the strut-braced wing against the unbraced cantilever wing, highlighting the break-even aspect ratio and marginal glide gains as strut length and mass grow."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Glide ratio vs AR
ax1.plot(trade["AR"], trade["cant_LD"], "o--", color="steelblue", lw=1.8, label="Cantilever (Unbraced)")
ax1.plot(trade["AR"], trade["max_LD"], "s-", color="crimson", lw=2.2, label="Strut-Braced Wing")
ax1.axhline(cant_ld_base, color="gray", ls=":", label=f"Baseline Cantilever ({cant_ld_base:.1f})")
ax1.axvline(ar_breakeven, color="forestgreen", ls="--", alpha=0.7, label=f"Break-even AR ({ar_breakeven:.1f})")
ax1.axvline(ar_diminish, color="darkorange", ls="--", alpha=0.7, label=f"Diminishing AR ({ar_diminish:.0f})")

ax1.set_xlabel("Wing Aspect Ratio")
ax1.set_ylabel("Best Glide Ratio (L/D)")
ax1.set_title("Glide Ratio vs Aspect Ratio", fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8)

# Subplot 2: Drag coefficient breakdown and marginal gain
ax2.plot(trade["AR"], trade["CD_profile"] * 1e4, "^-", color="firebrick", lw=1.8, label="Profile Drag ($10^4 C_{Dp}$)")
ax2.plot(trade["AR"], trade["CD_induced"] * 1e4, "v--", color="navy", lw=1.8, label="Induced Drag ($10^4 C_{Di}$)")
ax2.plot(trade["AR"], trade["CD"] * 1e4, "D-.", color="black", lw=1.8, label="Total Drag ($10^4 C_D$)")
ax2.set_xlabel("Wing Aspect Ratio")
ax2.set_ylabel("Drag Coefficient ($C_D \\times 10^4$)")
ax2.set_title("Drag Breakdown & Marginal Glide Gain", fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

ax2_twin = ax2.twinx()
ax2_twin.plot(trade["AR"], trade["dld_dar"], "*-", color="darkorange", lw=2.0, label="$\\Delta(L/D) / \\Delta AR$")
ax2_twin.set_ylabel("Marginal Gain $\\Delta(L/D) / \\Delta AR$", color="darkorange")
ax2_twin.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="darkorange")
ax2_twin.set_ylim(0, 0.45)

lines1, labels1 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax2.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc="upper right", fontsize=7.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
